title: Huginn – agents
intro: Agent state from the heartbeat (every minute). An agent without a signal for 3 minutes is marked offline.
updateTip: Installer of the latest agent version without a token: double-clicking it on a computer with the agent, or deploying it via GPO/Intune, replaces the version; registration and settings are kept. It cannot register new computers (Bifröst → token).

orphans.title: Valid certificates of agents not on the list ({{count}})
orphans.text: These agents were removed from the list, but their certificates are still valid – anyone with the private key could send events on their behalf. Revoke them (recorded in the audit log).
orphans.prompt:
Revoke the certificates of the removed agent {{id}}?

Reason:
orphans.defaultReason: agent removed from the list without revocation

search: Search: agent, host, IP, version, group

empty.title: No agents
empty.text: Agents appear here after their first heartbeat. Agent version 0.4.0 or later is required (older versions send events but do not report their state).

state.retiredTip: The agent certificate is revoked (uninstalled with a token or revoked in the panel) – the agent can no longer send events. The history is kept.

issue.protection_down: agent service protection is not working{{error}}
issue.tamper: agent tampering attempts in the last 24 h: {{n}} (see agent details)
issue.buffer_backlog: disk buffer: {{batches}} batches ({{mb}} MB) waiting to be sent for {{span}}
issue.buffer_full: the agent disk buffer is full
issue.buffer_dropped: events lost from the full disk buffer: {{n}}
issue.sysmon_missing: Sysmon is required in the group – it is not installed
issue.sysmon_unknown: Sysmon is required in the group – the agent does not report its state (upgrade to 0.6.2+)
issue.clock: the computer clock {{dir}} by {{s}} s compared to the server
issue.w32time: Windows Time service (W32Time) disabled – the clock is not synchronised
issue.sysmon_config: Sysmon configuration ({{config}}) differs from most of the group ({{common}})

detail.groupChanged: Group changed – the agent fetches the new configuration within about 5 minutes.
detail.removeConfirm:
Remove agent {{id}} from the list?

Its certificates will be revoked – the agent will not send any more events, even if it is still running. It can come back only through a new token registration. The event and alert history is kept.
detail.revokePrompt:
Revoke the certificates of agent {{id}}? The agent immediately loses access to the server (e.g. a lost laptop).

Reason:
detail.revoked: Certificates revoked: {{n}}. The agent will no longer connect to the server.
detail.noCerts: No certificates issued by the panel (agent from a lab package).
detail.bufferOld: Agent older than 0.6.0 – no disk buffer.
detail.bufferOff: Disabled – without connectivity events wait in the Windows event log.
detail.clockOld: Agent older than 0.6.0 or not measured yet.

update.retry: Agent update to {{v}} failed – a retry is scheduled

protection.title: Agent protection
protection.known: Valid tokens known to the agent: {{n}}.

protected.label: protected
protected.hint: A computer administrator cannot stop or uninstall the agent without a token from the panel.

open.label: unprotected
open.hint: The service has regular permissions – the agent restores protection within 30 s.

other.label: permissions changed
other.hint: The service permissions were changed externally.

error.label: error
error.hint: The agent cannot check or set the service permissions.

off.label: disabled
off.hint: Protection is disabled in the agent group (Agent groups).

unknown.label: not supported
unknown.hint: Agent older than 0.7.0, a collector or a connector (no Windows service).

protection.onlyNow: The token is shown only now
protection.onlyNowText: Save it or pass it to the person doing the work on the computer. The panel stores only a hash. The token is single-use and works only on this computer until {{date}}.
protection.refreshNote: The agent fetches the token hash from the panel – a command with a token refreshes the configuration itself, so it works right away.
protection.intro: A single-use token lets you stop or uninstall the agent on this one computer. A new token revokes the previous unused one. Generating it is recorded in the audit log.
protection.passwordHint: The token weakens the computer's protection – confirm with your password.

limits.heartbeatReturn: alert after {{n}} min offline (and on return)

groups.title: Agent groups
groups.intro: A group defines which events the agents collect (profile) and how many resources they may use. Agents fetch the configuration every 5 minutes or so and apply it without a restart.
groups.saved: Saved. The group's agents fetch the new configuration within about 5 minutes and apply it without a restart.
groups.profileHint: Set of channels and Event IDs (roadmap, appendix B)
groups.name: Name

f.priorityHint: Lower = yields to the user's programs
f.memSoftHint: MB, the agent saves memory above it
f.memHardHint: MB, Windows will not allow exceeding it
f.bufferHint: MB for batches without connectivity (agent 0.6+), 0 = disabled; default 1024
f.onFullHint: Pause: events wait in the Windows event log; drop: the oldest batches are lost
f.heartbeatHint: A Gjallarhorn alert when the agent sends no heartbeat for this many minutes (5–10,080); empty or 0 = no alert (e.g. workstations switched off at night)
f.sysmonHint: The panel reports computers without Sysmon, with Sysmon stopped or with a configuration different from most of the group. The agent does not install it – deployment: deploy/windows/sysmon.ps1 (GPO).
f.protectionHint: A computer administrator cannot stop or uninstall the agent without a single-use token from the panel (Huginn → agent → Uninstall token); attempts without a token, killing the process and changing the service permissions raise the “Agent tampering attempt” alert. Disabling restores regular service permissions.
f.notifyReturn: Also notify when the agent returns
f.notifyReturnHint: When an agent of this group sends a heartbeat again, the connectivity-loss alert closes itself and a “resolved” message with the outage length goes to the notification channels. Requires the connectivity-loss alert.
f.autoUpdateHint: Agents of the group (0.10+) install the agent version from the server themselves: Windows (0.10+) downloads the MSI installer, Linux (0.12+) the program for its architecture; the agent checks the SHA-256 sum and installs the new version within 30 minutes (random – no load spike on the server); Linux returns to the previous version when the new one does not start; a failed attempt is retried after 6 hours. Never a downgrade.
f.autoUpdateNoMsi: The server has no MSI installer or Linux program with a version number (deploy.sh agent / installation bundle).
f.autoUpdatePassword: The panel will be able to run the installer on the computers of this group – confirm enabling it.
f.iisHint: Agents of the group (0.10+) also read IIS logs in W3C format from C:\inetpub\logs\LogFiles (each site separately; another directory – iis.log_dir in agent.yaml). A new agent starts with the current day's file, without history. On computers without IIS the agent reports a warning.

deploy.title: Bifröst – agent deployment
deploy.intro: An enrolment token lets you install agents without preparing certificates for each computer.
deploy.noPerm: Enrolment tokens and installer packages are created by someone with the “Agent deployment – change” permission.
disabledText: No agents CA on the server. Create it with
and copy agents-ca.crt and agents-ca.key to the stack's certs directory.
deploy.how1: You create a token for a group of computers (event profile, validity, install limit).
deploy.how2: You download the MSI installer (one file – double-click or deploy via GPO/Intune) or copy the command.
deploy.how3: Updating installed agents: Huginn → “Download agent update (MSI)” – a file without a token; the new version replaces the old one and the registration is kept.
deploy.how4: The agent generates its key on the computer, enrols with the token and gets a 90-day certificate – it renews it itself.
deploy.how5: After deployment revoke the token. Lost computer: Huginn → agent → “Revoke certificate”.
deploy.revokeConfirm: Revoke token “{{name}}”? Agents enrolled with it keep working.
deploy.groupHint: Enrolled agents join this group (event profile and limits)
deploy.onlyNow: You see the token only now
deploy.onlyNowText: The panel stores only its hash. Download the package or copy the token now – later you can only revoke it and create a new one.
deploy.msiText: One file with the server address and token built in: double-clicking it installs and enrols the agent, and on a computer that already has the agent – upgrades it. Deploy the same file via GPO, Intune or SCCM without parameters. The file contains the token – anyone who gets it can enrol a computer while the token is valid (set a short validity or an install limit). The agent generates its key on the computer; there is no private key in the file.
deploy.zip: ZIP package (program, CA, token, scripts – installation without MSI)
deploy.mass: Mass deployment (GPO, Intune, SCCM) – command run as SYSTEM or administrator:
deploy.linuxText: Program, CA, server address, token and install.sh. Extract it on the server and run sudo ./install.sh. Mass deployment (Ansible, script) – command run from the program folder:
